scope: Six integration families against frozen production entrypoints after implementation/root release; no duplicate VM or proof jobs.

families.entrypoint: public capsule verifier, then separately authorized recovery consumer
faults: first mirror absent or corrupt, second exact selected object present
wide PK absent for compact-role or recover-only operation
families.expected: Exact root-matching complete public capsule may verify without operator/old cache; rejected mirror recorded; no currentness claim from capsule alone. Recover-only needs no PK/prover; compact proving cannot require wide PK.
families.evidence_tier: PUBLIC_OBJECTS_ONLY until selected compact integration is released
families.private_gate: No actual backup mounted during public-only test

families.entrypoint: production capsule plus descriptor/manifest selection gate
faults: recomputed internal manifest/object hashes against unchanged outside root
wrong D or VK with same dimensions
families.expected: Reject before backup contents and parameter decoding; a newly self-consistent unselected root never becomes authority.
families.private_gate: Synthetic non-seed sentinel IN_OPEN count zero

families.entrypoint: production object resolver/verifier, using owned sandbox copies only
faults: public hardlink alias to synthetic backup sentinel
all mirrors disagree with selected digest
families.expected: Unavailable or invalid, never partial success/current balance; no mixed-provider object prefix splice; no private-content open.
families.private_gate: Synthetic sentinel IN_OPEN count zero; actual backups/caches/releases unmounted

families.entrypoint: new history consumer/replay adapter with authenticated public fixture inventory
faults: wrong founding point or history tip
valid individual header/body bytes without authenticated accepted membership
missing old bulk pages accompanied by copied complete-scan flags
families.expected: Reject required lineage gaps/ancestry conflicts or label historical bytes-only status. A separately defined sparse result may omit unrelated bulk pages but must never claim an old full scan was freshly performed.
families.evidence_tier: PUBLIC_HISTORY_GATE; no new SDK/native run unless specifically scheduled
families.private_gate: No backup read or current spendable result on incomplete history

families.entrypoint: new current-observation composition boundary; fake transport explicitly labeled in offline controls
faults: fresh view not bound to capsule history tip
wrong amount/script for current reserve or payout
post-query spend/removal of any live point
node unavailable or required history pruned
families.expected: Historical capsule may remain verified; currentness/spendability remains unknown or incomplete. No missing-data-to-zero conversion. Fake transport is not consensus evidence.
families.evidence_tier: OFFLINE_COMPOSITION_REJECTION; actual fresh-node check requires separate root release
families.private_gate: Synthetic sentinel unopened for invalid current-dependent action; no automatic broadcast or revealing fallback

families.entrypoint: actual selected compact loader and owner entrypoint after implementation/root execution release
faults: valid selected full PK without requested parameters-ready identity
public input alias to synthetic backup
families.expected: Selection then complete owned-PK length/hash before decode, decoder exhaustion plus extracted VK/role/dimensions, selected parameters-ready, then private-input access. Every negative stops before synthetic sentinel open.
families.evidence_tier: DEFERRED_ACTUAL_SELECTED_PUBLIC_PK_LOADER; no proof generation in this lane
families.private_gate: Synthetic non-seed sentinel only; scheduled genuine owner rehearsal supplies positive private/proof evidence separately

stop_rules: No execution until concrete production API/source and root scope are frozen
No actual private backup, PK blob, network request, native VM or proof before explicit root release
No destructive mutation outside fresh owned sandbox fixture copies
No check weakening or post-result expected-outcome changes
No cryptographic, fresh-consensus, financial-privacy or production qualification from public/synthetic controls
